tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: This week, we're examining how social media affects people's daily social interactions and self-confidence. Some researchers suggest that social media can make people feel lonely and insecure because they constantly compare their lives to others' posts and receive negative comments from strangers. Others argue that social media helps people maintain friendships, find communities with shared interests, and receive encouragement from supportive networks. Which view is more accurate? Provide details to explain your choice.

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: I believe social media negatively affects people's social relationships and self-confidence in significant ways. When people constantly see others' vacation photos, achievements, and perfect moments, they feel inadequate about their own lives and accomplishments. Additionally, negative comments and online arguments create stress and make people hesitant to express their genuine opinions, leading to superficial interactions rather than meaningful friendships.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I think social media can positively impact people's social connections and personal confidence when used thoughtfully. It allows people to maintain friendships across long distances, find communities with shared hobbies or interests, and receive encouragement during difficult times. Social media also gives shy individuals comfortable platforms to express themselves and build confidence through positive interactions with supportive online communities.
